pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - Elevated 5xx error rate on inference-prod (model-runner pool). Triggered at 13:02 UTC. Pager sent to @oncall. See /incident/INF-4987
ash_kapoor: Acknowledging, jumping in. Any initial mitigation runbooks we should trigger? :thinking_face:
kevin_lin: Seeing a spike in 502/503s and timeouts from model-runner-d-3/4. Attaching recent logs.
kevin_lin: ```
[13:01:58] model-runner-d-3 | segfault at 0x7f9eabf3
[13:02:00] kernel: show_stack+0x1a/0x20
[13:02:01] inference: FATAL: double free in attention_kernel.c:112
[13:02:02] grpc: HTTP/2 closed with 503
```
sophia_mueller: ugh segfaults. Can we temporarily route traffic away from model-runner-d pool to fallback models/regions? Suggest enabling model-fallback and scaling up runners in us-west-2.
maria_gonzalez: Quick impact numbers: error-rate jumped from 0.6% -> 12% across inference-prod. Affected customers: 4 enterprise tenants (redacted), 18% of requests from eng-samples. Latency p95 rose from 180ms -> 700ms.
ash_kapoor: Action plan: 1) Reroute traffic off model-runner-d to model-runner-e (fallback) 2) Disable hot-quant path for this model 3) Roll a patch to strip problematic kernel until rootcause. Who can run the reroute now?
oncall: I can run the reroute and set a temporary per-tenant throttle. Running now.
oncall: `/reroute --from pool=model-runner-d --to pool=model-runner-e --weight=100` -> started
eng-sre-bot: Reroute task submitted: job 4987-reroute-1. Estimated convergence 60s.
kevin_lin: Confirming logs show restarts on runner-d-3 every ~12s, OOMs not present but allocator errors before segfault. Likely memory corruption from quant kernel.
sophia_mueller: On rollback: disable quantized attention kernels via runtime flag: `--qattn=off` on the runner image. Who has privileges to toggle?
ash_kapoor: I have perms. Pushing runtime flag to model-runner-e and model-runner-f to avoid hitting same code path if traffic shifts.
kevin_lin: Pushed `--qattn=off` to pools e/f. Please watch for regression tests.
maria_gonzalez: Customer impact timeline: started 13:01 UTC, reroute initiated 13:04 UTC. Error-rate dropped to 2.1% by 13:07 UTC after reroute. Still elevated for a small subset of requests routed via region eu-central-1 (proxying to d pool cached values).
ash_kapoor: Good. Next: create a hotpatch to remove the offending kernel symbol from the runtime and schedule a safe rollforward. @kevin can you prepare the hotpatch PR and a canary plan?
kevin_lin: On it. I will open PR, build a canary image, and run canary against synthetic load in staging, then promote to a small percentage in prod (10%) before full rollout.
sophia_mueller: Notify support & customers: Send a brief note to support-channel with affected tenant list and ETA for fix. Also mark incident on the status page as "Degraded - partial".
maria_gonzalez: I pushed a short status message to #support-incidents and updated the status page. ETA for full fix ~90min after hotpatch validated.
oncall: Handing off now to daytime rotation. Current state: traffic rerouted, qattn disabled, error-rate trending down. Pager remains open for watch.
ash_kapoor: Thanks. Leaving notes in incident doc: suspected memory corruption in quant attention kernel. Followups: full core dump analysis, unit tests on qattn path, postmortem with mitigations list.
kevin_lin: Uploading core dump and minimal repro to the incident doc: /s3/infra/incidents/INF-4987/dumps.tar.gz
eng-sre-bot: Reminder: runbook step 'notify-exec' not yet completed. Assigned to ash_kapoor.
ash_kapoor: Done. Notified execs with summary and impact numbers.
maria_gonzalez: Final update before handoff: error-rate stabilized at 0.9% across prod, p95 latency back to 220ms. Closing immediate mitigations, keeping incident open for postmortem.
oncall: Acknowledged handoff. If error-rate creeps >3% or new segfaults appear -> page. :thumbsup:
pagerduty-bot: Incident INF-4987 status: mitigated (watch) - oncall handoff -> daytime. Incident lead: ash_kapoor. Postmortem assigned: kevin_lin.```
